project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code, refresh token) with JWT-based session management, multi-tenant token isolation, and rate limiting per client.

components.name: PSD2 open banking connectors
components.description: Account information and payment initiation endpoints compliant with PSD2/Berlin Group, including strong customer authentication (SCA) and consent management.

components.name: Transaction ledger service
components.description: Double-entry transaction ledger with idempotent writes, daily reconciliation jobs and an audit trail of every balance change.

components.name: Push and email notifications
components.description: Event-driven notifications for transaction alerts and security events delivered via APNs/FCM and transactional email.

project_summary: Automated loan origination platform with credit scoring and e-signature

components.name: Credit scoring engine
components.description: Rules-and-model based credit scoring service that ingests bureau data and bank statements, returning a risk band and recommended limit with full explainability logs.

components.name: Loan origination workflow
components.description: Configurable application workflow with KYC checks, document upload, underwriting queue and automatic decisioning thresholds.

components.name: E-signature integration
components.description: Integration with a qualified e-signature provider for legally binding loan contracts, including webhook handling and signed-document archival.

components.name: Regulatory reporting export
components.description: Scheduled export of portfolio metrics and delinquency reports in regulator-mandated formats.

project_summary: Real-time payments gateway with fraud detection and reconciliation

components.name: Payment gateway core
components.description: High-throughput payment authorization and capture service with idempotency keys, retry semantics and pluggable acquirer adapters.

components.name: Real-time fraud detection
components.description: Streaming fraud scoring on the authorization path using velocity rules and a gradient-boosted model served with sub-50ms latency.

components.name: Settlement reconciliation
components.description: Daily settlement file ingestion and three-way reconciliation between gateway, acquirer and ledger with exception queues.

components.name: Merchant dashboard
components.description: Merchant-facing dashboard for transaction search, refunds and payout tracking.

components.name: Portfolio optimization service
components.description: Mean-variance optimization and drift-based rebalancing engine that proposes trades to bring client portfolios back to target allocations.

components.name: Market data ingestion
components.description: Scheduled ingestion of end-of-day prices and corporate actions from a market data vendor with caching and gap detection.

components.name: Client onboarding and risk profiling
components.description: Questionnaire-driven risk profiling that maps a client to a model portfolio and persists the suitability record.

project_summary: Headless e-commerce storefront with personalized recommendations

components.name: Product catalog API
components.description: GraphQL catalog API with faceted search, inventory availability and multi-currency pricing backed by Elasticsearch.

components.name: Cart and checkout service
components.description: Stateless cart service with promotion engine, tax calculation and a checkout orchestration that integrates the payment provider.

components.name: Personalized recommendations
components.description: Collaborative-filtering recommendations served from a feature store and exposed as a low-latency API for product and cart pages.

components.name: Storefront PWA
components.description: Progressive web app storefront consuming the headless APIs with server-side rendering for SEO.

project_summary: Multi-vendor marketplace with vendor payouts and dispute handling

components.name: Vendor onboarding and KYC
components.description: Vendor self-service onboarding with identity verification, payout account setup and a manual review queue.

components.name: Split order management
components.description: Order splitting across vendors, per-vendor fulfillment state machines and customer-facing consolidated order tracking.

components.name: Vendor payouts engine
components.description: Scheduled marketplace payouts with commission calculation, holdback for disputes and reconciliation against the payment processor.

components.name: Dispute and refund handling
components.description: Buyer-seller dispute workflow with evidence upload, SLA timers and partial refund support.

project_summary: Grocery delivery app with slot booking and route optimization

components.name: Delivery slot booking
components.description: Capacity-aware delivery slot service with optimistic locking to prevent overbooking and dynamic pricing for peak windows.

components.name: Route optimization service
components.description: Vehicle routing optimization that batches orders into delivery runs minimizing distance under time-window and capacity constraints.

components.name: Real-time inventory sync
components.description: Near-real-time inventory synchronization from store systems with out-of-stock substitution suggestions.

project_summary: Fashion returns management and resale portal

components.name: Returns portal
components.description: Self-service returns portal with label generation, reason capture and automatic restock or resale routing.

components.name: Item grading workflow
components.description: Warehouse grading workflow that classifies returned items and assigns resale price tiers.

components.name: Resale listing sync
components.description: Synchronization of graded resale items to the secondary storefront with availability and pricing updates.

project_summary: Patient appointment and telemedicine platform with HL7/FHIR integration

components.name: FHIR integration layer
components.description: HL7 FHIR R4 integration that maps internal patient and encounter records to the hospital EHR, with terminology mapping and audit logging.

components.name: Appointment scheduling
components.description: Scheduling engine with clinician availability, resource booking, reminders and a waitlist for cancellations.

components.name: Telemedicine video sessions
components.description: WebRTC-based video consultation with waiting room, in-call notes and secure recording consent handling.

components.name: Consent and audit module
components.description: GDPR-aligned consent capture and immutable access audit trail for protected health information.

project_summary: Remote patient monitoring with wearable data ingestion and alerts

components.name: Wearable data ingestion
components.description: High-volume ingestion pipeline for heart-rate, SpO2 and activity streams from wearables, with deduplication and schema validation.

components.name: Clinical alerting engine
components.description: Threshold and trend-based alerting that escalates abnormal vitals to care teams with configurable rules per condition.

components.name: Care team dashboard
components.description: Dashboard for clinicians to triage alerts, view patient trends and acknowledge interventions.

project_summary: Pharmacy inventory and prescription fulfillment system

components.name: Prescription intake and validation
components.description: Electronic prescription intake with drug-interaction checks, dosage validation and pharmacist review queue.

components.name: Inventory and reorder
components.description: Lot-and-expiry-aware inventory with automatic reorder points and supplier purchase orders.

components.name: Dispensing and labeling
components.description: Dispensing workflow that prints compliant labels and records controlled-substance movements.

project_summary: Clinical trial data capture and anonymization platform

components.name: Electronic data capture forms
components.description: Configurable eCRF builder with validation rules, query management and per-site access control for trial data entry.

components.name: De-identification service
components.description: Pseudonymization and de-identification pipeline that strips direct identifiers and applies k-anonymity checks before export.

components.name: Regulatory dataset export
components.description: CDISC-aligned dataset export for regulatory submission with reproducible builds and a manifest of transformations.

project_summary: Factory IoT telemetry and predictive maintenance system

components.name: Sensor telemetry ingestion
components.description: MQTT-based ingestion of machine sensor telemetry into a time-series store, with edge buffering and out-of-order handling.

components.name: Predictive maintenance models
components.description: Anomaly detection and remaining-useful-life models that flag machines at risk of failure and schedule maintenance windows.

components.name: SCADA dashboard integration
components.description: Read-only integration with the plant SCADA system to overlay predictive alerts on existing operator dashboards.

project_summary: Warehouse management system with automated guided vehicle coordination

components.name: Warehouse management core
components.description: Inventory, putaway and picking management with wave planning and barcode/RFID scanning support.

components.name: AGV coordination service
components.description: Coordination service that assigns tasks to automated guided vehicles, manages traffic on shared aisles and recovers from stalls.

components.name: Yard and dock scheduling
components.description: Dock-door appointment scheduling and yard movement tracking to reduce trailer dwell time.

components.name: Operations KPI reporting
components.description: Throughput, accuracy and utilization reporting with shift-level rollups.

project_summary: Energy grid monitoring and demand-response platform

components.name: Smart meter data pipeline
components.description: Ingestion and validation of smart-meter interval data at scale, with gap filling and unit normalization.

components.name: Demand-response engine
components.description: Demand-response event engine that dispatches load-shedding signals to participating sites and verifies delivered curtailment.

components.name: Load forecasting service
components.description: Short-term load forecasting per substation feeding the demand-response scheduler.
